subtasks: Place the alarm clock on the drawer, put the figurine on the stand, place the mouse on the mouse pad, and push the keyboard into the frame.
Push the keyboard to the center of its marked frame so it covers the frame, flat and facing the screen.
Center the upright figurine on the gray square beside the cabinet by moving its round foot slightly left. Keep it upright and clear the cabinet and keyboard, then return both arms with open grippers.
